## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Root cause is identified.
- [ ] The issue is reproducible before the fix.
- [ ] The fix is verified.
- [ ] Regression coverage is added where appropriate.
- [ ] No transaction or audit history is deleted or silently rewritten.
- [ ] Production build succeeds.
